material_facts.statement: CRISIL reaffirmed Craftsman Automation at Crisil AA-/Stable for long-term and Crisil A1+ short-term on bank facilities enhanced to Rs 3,950 crore from Rs 2,300 crore (12 December 2025).
Consolidated operating revenue was Rs 3,786 crore in H1 FY2026 against Rs 2,365 crore a year earlier.
Consolidated revenue grew 28% to Rs 5,693 crore in fiscal 2025 from Rs 4,452 crore; the aluminium segment grew about 41%.
Aluminium contributed over 60% of H1 FY2026 revenue, powertrain 27% and industrial and engineering 13%.
Consolidated operating margin fell to 14.9% in fiscal 2025 from about 20% earlier, owing to consolidation of Sunbeam and lower standalone margins.
Operating margin was about 15% in H1 FY2026 versus 16.5% a year earlier; CRISIL expects about 15% for the year.
Gearing was about 0.78 times at 31 March 2025 against 0.91 times a year earlier.
Interest cover was 3.97 times and debt to EBITDA 2.53 times in fiscal 2025 versus 5.79 times and 1.70 times in fiscal 2023.
Debt was Rs 2,141 crore at 31 March 2025 and Rs 3,038 crore at 30 September 2025, expected near Rs 3,500 crore by March 2026.
Debt to EBITDA is expected at about 2.8 to 2.9 times in fiscal 2026 and below 2.5 times thereafter.
Capex of about Rs 1,200 crore is planned in fiscal 2026 for Sunbeam modernisation, phase II expansions and greenfield facilities.
The company raised Rs 1,200 crore through a QIP in June 2024 (net Rs 1,176.7 crore), repaying over Rs 650 crore of debt and buying the residual 24% of DR Axion for Rs 250 crore.
CRISIL rates subsidiary Sunbeam Lightweighting at BBB-/Positive/A3 and DR Axion at AA-/Stable/A1+.
Gross current assets average 160 to 170 days, with inventory of close to 4 months and receivables near 2 months.
Liquidity is strong: annual accruals of about Rs 760 crore this fiscal against repayments of about Rs 180 crore, and average utilisation of the Rs 1,010 crore standalone bank limit was about 56%.
The auto segment will account for over 85% of revenues, making performance vulnerable to an auto sector slowdown.
Board is 67% independent directors and 33% women.
Consolidated operating revenue was Rs 8,069.27 crore in FY2026 against Rs 5,690.48 crore in FY2025.
Standalone operating revenue was Rs 4,818.08 crore in FY2026 against Rs 3,847.95 crore.
Consolidated EBITDA was Rs 1,300.07 crore in FY2026 against Rs 858.78 crore in FY2025.
Consolidated finance cost was Rs 308.97 crore against Rs 216.64 crore; depreciation Rs 443.85 crore against Rs 347.02 crore.
Consolidated profit before tax was Rs 534.3 crore and profit after tax Rs 383.99 crore in FY2026 (FY2025: Rs 269.65 crore and Rs 200.87 crore).
Standalone profit after tax was Rs 221.47 crore in FY2026 against Rs 93.69 crore.
Consolidated other equity closed at Rs 3,252.13 crore at 31 March 2026.
Dividend paid in the year was Rs 11.93 crore against Rs 23.77 crore the previous year.
The board proposed a final dividend of Rs 11.25 per share of Rs 5 face value, a total of about Rs 26.84 crore.
Standalone long-term borrowings (including current portion) were Rs 2,202.75 crore at 31 March 2026 against Rs 1,509.56 crore a year earlier.
Standalone secured rupee term loans from banks stood at Rs 1,869.35 crore non-current and Rs 154.77 crore current at March 2026.
This is the 40th annual report of the company, for the year ended 31 March 2026.
